description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ViewSourceProperties', which extends 'ViewList' and handles displaying source properties for a connector within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes a constructor and a display method that fetches source properties, assigns variables to a template engine, and renders a template for configuring connector source properties.

classes.name: ViewSourceProperties
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering the source properties configuration interface for connectors in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent constructor of 'ViewList'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and renders the source properties form by fetching source details, preparing data, and assigning variables to the template engine before rendering the template.
